rows.note: Use this colloquial form mainly in questions, negatives, and conditional contexts.

example.english: Do you want to eat anything?
example.jyutping: nei5 soeng2 sik6 mat1 je5 aa3

rows.note: Use this as the clearest all-purpose equivalent for any thing whatsoever.

example.english: If you don't understand anything, you can ask me.
example.traditional: 你有任何嘢唔明，都可以問我。
example.jyutping: nei5 jau5 jam4 ho4 je5 m4 ming4 dou1 ho2 ji5 man6 ngo5

rows.note: Use this before a predicate when stressing that no thing is excluded, especially with 都 or a negative.

example.english: I don't want to eat anything.
example.jyutping: ngo5 mat1 je5 dou1 m4 soeng2 sik6
